tools.name: make_fishbone
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a fishbone, Ishikawa or cause and effect diagram drawn for a problem, for example "make a fishbone for late deliveries" or "6M fishbone template for high scrap rate". Takes the problem (the effect), 2 to 8 categories with up to 10 causes each and up to 5 sub-causes per c

tools.name: check_fishbone
tools.description: Use this when the user wants their fishbone or cause and effect list reviewed before drawing, for example "check my fishbone causes for duplicates" or "how many pages will this Ishikawa diagram need". Takes the same problem and categories as make_fishbone. Returns counts per category, empty categori
